scope: detailed event batches and content-addressed checkpoint references

checks.round_trip: preserve work stamps, event types, participants, creation/deletion lists, rule ID, provenance, opaque deltas, and checkpoint format/size/digest
checks.independent: an externally encoded two-event batch yields 2 events, 2 births, 1 death, 1 observed event and 1 reconstructed event, plus one accepted checkpoint reference
checks.rejection: reject malformed record lengths, counts, work stamps, flags, entity lists and checkpoint descriptors before indexing the failed chunk
checks.compatibility: preserve prior categorical, aggregate event, relational and mock trace digests and diagnostics; repeat the checks against the substrate-free install

limits: wire format and tier-0 counts only; reference targets and scientific claims are outside this protocol
